name: EUDR soy region tour
description: A compliant soy plot beside one cleared after 2020 (Sorriso area, Mato Grosso). Synthetic demo geometry.

steps.say: A European soy importer verifies supplier plots against the 31 December 2020 EUDR cutoff.
This plot is compliant: stable crop seasonality, no clearing after the cutoff.
Its neighbour lost forest cover in August 2022. Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 radar agree.
An analyst confirms, and a signed evidence pack is exported. Evidence to support due diligence, not certification.
